game.name: Dragon Age : Origins (Japan)(Disc 1)
game.desc: Dragon Age: Origins is an Xbox 360 role-playing game based on a previously unseen fantasy universe. An intuitive team combat system allows you to defeat hordes of enemies. Depending on his alliances and his choices, the player can redefine the environment in which he evolves. Each player participates in a unique prelude that determines their vision of the world and how the world perceives it, which then has a great influence on the course of the adventure.
